{{Quote|For time beyond knowing, we lived in that sea, in an area that brought us food and warmth. For time beyond knowing, we were content&hellip; until the four-limbs came! They built over our home, almost destroying us. With our food taken, we needed more. We found the dianoga were most suggestible&mdash;we could bond with them&hellip; control them. The '''colony creature''' was a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] that resided in the [[Ocean/Legends|oceans]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Mon Calamari]]. The creature was made up of billions of independent cells that shared a collective consciousness, and it could also exert a weak form of [[Telepathy/Legends|mind control]] that enabled it to control the minds of [[Dianoga/Legends|dianoga]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] established an [[Mon Calamari underwater base|underwater base]] on the seabed near to the colony creature's home. The presence of the base cut off the creature's food supply, almost [[Death/Legends|killing]] it, but it survived by exerting control over the minds of passing dianoga and using them to bring it food. Seeking revenge, the creature then sent out a large force of dianoga to assault the underwater base. The [[Attack on the Mon Calamari underwater base|attack]] was repulsed by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]], and afterward Kenobi tracked down the colony creature. The Jedi attempted to negotiate with the creature, but it rejected his call to stop the fighting and instead it sent out more dianoga to launch a renewed attack on the base. However, via the application of the [[Living Force/Legends|Living Force]] Kenobi became one with the soul of the colony creature and reached an accordance with it. The creature subsequently negotiated a peace resolution with the Mon Calamari [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] whereby the Mon Calamari would move their base and in return, the creature would aid them with tracking down [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] invaders.
